summary: Constructor/initializer: calls GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, zeroes the leading dwords and byte 0x1C, sets the +0x4 dword to 1065353216 (1.0f) as a unit-vector-like component, and zeroes the trailing +0x2C and +0x30 dwords before returning this.

operations.description: Call GlobalZeroInit_c2a0(this) to run the shared zero-initialization helper.
Set the dword at this+0x0 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x4 to 1065353216 (1.0f), the unit component.
Set the dword at this+0x8 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0xC to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x10 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x14 to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x18 to 0.
Set the byte at this+0x1C to 0 (byte-width write, distinct from the dword writes).
Set the dword at this+0x2C to 0.
Set the dword at this+0x30 to 0.
Return this as the initialized object.

unresolved: Field roles (especially why +0x4 receives 1.0f while all other listed fields are zeroed) depend on the owning object's layout, which is unknown.
Byte-width write at +0x1C inside an otherwise dword-initialized struct may indicate a flag or bitfield sub-field.
